example_sentences.english: From the standpoint of Suzuki, he thinks that company A being bought by company B is a good thing. (Unnatural Japanese)

general_translation: As well, Besides, In addition to
formation: Verb + 上（うえ）(に)［い］Adjective + 上（うえ）(に)［な］Adjective + な(1) + 上（うえ）(に)Noun + の(1) + 上（うえ）(に)(1) である
casual_structure: Verb + 上（うえ）(に)［い］Adjective + 上（うえ）(に)［な］Adjective + な(1) + 上（うえ）(に)Noun + の(1) + 上（うえ）(に)(1) である
explanation: A slightly formal structure which adds information on top of (A), as a means of saying something in addition.

example_sentences.japanese: そのジムは安いうえに、私の家から近い。
example_sentences.english: As well as being cheap, that gym is close to my house. (on top of that)

example_sentences.japanese: 私の犬は子供を見ると吠えるうえに噛みつこうとするので子供には近づけさせないようにしています。
example_sentences.english: In addition to barking, my dog tries to bite children when he sees them, so I try not to let him get close to them.

example_sentences.japanese: 家の近所にあるレストランはまずいうえに、高いからいつも空いている。
example_sentences.english: The restaurant near my house is always empty because in addition to having bad food, they are expensive.

example_sentences.japanese: 高橋くんは無礼なうえに清潔感がないため、周りの人たちには避けられている。
example_sentences.english: Takahashi-kun is rude as well as unhygienic, so he is avoided by the people around him.

example_sentences.japanese: 彼女は調理師免許のうえに健康食アドバイザーの資格も持っているので、彼女が作る料理は健康的で美味しいです。
example_sentences.english: In addition to having a chef's license, she also has qualification as a nutrition advisor, so the food she makes is healthy and delicious.

example_sentences.japanese: あそこの駅は不便であるうえに利用者が減っている為、来月の中旬に取り壊されるそうだ。
example_sentences.english: I heard that the station over there is going to get torn down in the middle of next month because in addition to being inconvenient, it is losing users.

example_sentences.japanese: ケントさんは新聞記者であるうえにスーパーヒーローでもあった。
example_sentences.english: Kent-san was a newspaper reporter as well as a superhero.

example_sentences.japanese: あの店はリフォームしたうえに、メニューも変わったらしい。
example_sentences.english: I heard that restaurant changed its menu, in addition to being remodeled. (on top of)

example_sentences.japanese: 彼はお洒落なうえにイケメンだから、モテモテだ。
example_sentences.english: Because he is stylish as well as good-looking, he is well-liked. (on top of that)

example_sentences.japanese: 今日の宿題は簡単なうえに、少ない。
example_sentences.english: In addition to being easy, today's homework load was light. (on top of that)

example_sentences.japanese: あの人の説明は、曖昧なうえに不正確だ。
example_sentences.english: That person's explanation was vague, as well as inaccurate. (on top of that)

example_sentences.japanese: 彼は、怪しいうえに気持ち悪いから、まずもてない。
example_sentences.english: Besides being dodgy, he is also unpleasant so he is hardly popular with the ladies. (on top of that)

example_sentences.japanese: 友人は、知恵があるうえに勇ましいから頼りになります。
example_sentences.english: Because my friend is wise, as well as brave, he is reliable. (on top of that)

example_sentences.japanese: 園芸は、楽しいうえに達成感があります。
example_sentences.english: In addition to being fun, gardening also gives you a sense of achievement. (on top of that)

example_sentences.japanese: 今日のおかずは豪華なうえに品数も多いのだが、今日は何の日なんだろう？
example_sentences.english: Today's side dishes are extravagant as well as numerous. I wonder what the occasion is... (on top of that)

example_sentences.japanese: あの店は、美味しいうえに落ち着く雰囲気だから、また行きたい。
example_sentences.english: Because that shop has a calm atmosphere, in addition to being delicious, I want to go again. (on top of that)

example_sentences.japanese: 彼はお酒を飲むと、暴れるうえに悪態をつくから手に負えない。
example_sentences.english: If he drinks alcohol, in addition to being violent, he uses abusive language, so he is uncontrollable. (on top of that)

example_sentences.japanese: 彼女は、おとなしいうえに人見知りだから、なかなか友達ができません。
example_sentences.english: Because she is quiet as well as shy, she is not really able to make friends. (on top of that)

example_sentences.japanese: あの建築会社が建てる家は丈夫な上にお洒落なので、すごく人気があるらしい。
example_sentences.english: Apparently that building company is very popular right now because the houses they build are durable as well as stylish. (Natural Japanese)

example_sentences.japanese: 彼はハンサムな上に失礼だから、あまりモテない。
example_sentences.english: He is not very popular because in addition to being handsome, he is rude. (Unnatural Japanese)

general_translation: Since, Now that, As long as, If
formation: Verb + 以上（いじょう）(は)［い］Adjective + 以上（いじょう）(は)［な］Adjective + である + 以上（いじょう）(は)Noun + である + 以上（いじょう）(は)
casual_structure: Verb + 以上（いじょう）(は)［い］Adjective + 以上（いじょう）(は)［な］Adjective + である + 以上（いじょう）(は)Noun + である + 以上（いじょう）(は)
explanation: A formal expression stating that upon or above the situation of (A), (B) must or should be considered.

example_sentences.japanese: 試験を受けるいじょう、休むことはできない。
example_sentences.english: As long as I am taking the exam, I can't rest.

example_sentences.japanese: 猫を飼うと決めたいじょうは、最後まで責任を持って育てないといけないと思います。
example_sentences.english: Now that I have decided to keep a cat, I think that I have the responsibility to raise it until the end.

example_sentences.japanese: 体調が悪いいじょうは、会社に来ないでください。
example_sentences.english: As long as you are sick, please don't come into work.

example_sentences.japanese: 有名であるいじょうは、テレビではもちろん、ＳＮＳでも発言に気をつけなければいけません。
example_sentences.english: As long as you are famous, you will have to watch what you say, not only on television, but also on social networks.

example_sentences.japanese: この地域の住民であるいじょうは、この地域のルールをしっかりと守ってもらわないと困ります。
example_sentences.english: As long as you are a resident of this community, we need you to properly follow the rules of this community.

example_sentences.japanese: キャプテンに選ばれたいじょう、結果を残すために精一杯頑張ります！
example_sentences.english: Now that I have been chosen as captain, I will do my best to achieve results!

example_sentences.japanese: どんなに気を付けていても、人間であるいじょう、ミスは防げないよ。
example_sentences.english: No matter how careful you are, as long as you're human, you can't avoid making mistakes.

example_sentences.japanese: 親であるいじょうは子育てを頑張るべきだ。
example_sentences.english: Since you are a parent, you should do your best to raise your child.

example_sentences.japanese: 日本に来たいじょう、真剣に日本語の勉強をしたいと思います。
example_sentences.english: Now that I have come to Japan, I think I want to study Japanese seriously.

example_sentences.japanese: 都心に住んでいるいじょう、渋滞は避けられない。
example_sentences.english: Now that I am living in the city center, I can't avoid the traffic.

example_sentences.japanese: この条件で引き受けたいじょう、文句は言えない。
example_sentences.english: Now that I have agreed to these terms, I can't complain.

example_sentences.japanese: この日程で作業するいじょう、残業するしかありません。
example_sentences.english: Now that I am working this schedule, I have no choice but to do overtime.

example_sentences.japanese: 反対が過半数であるいじょう、この案は考え直すしかない。
example_sentences.english: Now that the opposition is the majority, there is no choice but to rethink this plan.

example_sentences.japanese: うちの会社に入社したいじょうは、ちゃんとした仕事をしてもらわないと困ります。
example_sentences.english: Now that you have joined our company, there will be trouble if we don't receive adequate work from you.

example_sentences.japanese: 芸能人であるいじょう、謝罪会見を開くしかない。
example_sentences.english: Now that he is an entertainer, he has no choice but to hold an apology interview.

example_sentences.japanese: 勝手に分解したいじょう、ちゃんと元に戻す責任がある。
example_sentences.english: Now that I have arbitrarily taken it apart, I have the responsibility to put it back together properly.

example_sentences.japanese: 一定の結果を出していないいじょう、あなたを解任するしかありません。
example_sentences.english: Now that you aren't showing consistent results, we have no choice but to dismiss you.

example_sentences.japanese: これだけの実力があるいじょう、期待されるのは当然のことです。
example_sentences.english: Now that I have this much ability, it is only natural that others would expect more from me.

general_translation: More than, No less than, Even more
formation: Verb + 以上（いじょう）に［い］Adjective + 以上（いじょう）に［な］Adjective + 以上（いじょう）にNoun + 以上（いじょう）に以上（いじょう） + の + Noun
casual_structure: Verb + 以上（いじょう）に［い］Adjective + 以上（いじょう）に［な］Adjective + 以上（いじょう）にNoun + 以上（いじょう）に以上（いじょう） + の + Noun
explanation: A grammar point which expresses that (A) is the minimum for which something will be no less than, or is more than.

example_sentences.japanese: 天気は予想いじょうに悪かった。
example_sentences.english: The weather was worse than I thought.

example_sentences.japanese: 私はスキーいじょうにスノーボードが好きだ。
example_sentences.english: I like snowboarding more than skiing.

example_sentences.japanese: 僕の最初のライブに想像していたいじょうの人が集まったので、すごく嬉しかった。
example_sentences.english: I was very happy that more people than I expected showed up to my first concert.

example_sentences.japanese: 私の先輩は思ったいじょうの人生を送っている。
example_sentences.english: My senpai is living a better life than I thought.

example_sentences.japanese: 新しく発売した商品の評判が思っていたいじょうに良かったのでびっくりした。
example_sentences.english: I was surprised to find that the newly launched product was more well-received than I had expected.

example_sentences.japanese: 今日の風は冷たいいじょうに痛い。
example_sentences.english: More than it is cold, today's wind is painful.

example_sentences.japanese: 今節約中だから必要いじょうにお金を使わないようにしてる。
example_sentences.english: Since I am saving money right now, I am trying not to use more money than necessary.

example_sentences.japanese: 彼には思ったいじょうの人生がある。
example_sentences.english: He has more of a life than I thought.

example_sentences.japanese: 彼女は、競馬いじょうに競輪が好き。
example_sentences.english: She likes bicycle racing more than horse racing.

example_sentences.japanese: お父さんのギャグは、僕のギャグいじょうにくだらない。
example_sentences.english: My father's jokes are more stupid than mine.

example_sentences.japanese: 彼は、カーブいじょうにシュートをよく投げる投手です。
example_sentences.english: He is a pitcher who throws screwballs more than curve balls.

example_sentences.japanese: 彼女は、僕いじょうに金魚に関心があるらしい。
example_sentences.english: It seems like she is more interested in goldfish than me.

example_sentences.japanese: この食品サンプルは、実物いじょうにリアルだ。
example_sentences.english: This replica food sample looks more realistic than the actual food.

example_sentences.japanese: 脇役の彼が、主役いじょうに目立っていた。
example_sentences.english: He, as a supporting actor, stood out more than the leading actor.

example_sentences.japanese: 食べられる量いじょうに、料理を注文してしまった。
example_sentences.english: I ordered more food than I am able to eat.

example_sentences.japanese: 僕の上司は、規律いじょうに利益を大切にする人です。
example_sentences.english: My boss is a person who cares about profit more than the rules.

example_sentences.japanese: あの人は、作者いじょうに好きなんじゃないかと思えるほどあの本が好きでたまらない。
example_sentences.english: That person likes that book very much, so much so that you could think they liked it more than the author.

example_sentences.japanese: 彼は温泉いじょうに、この旅館の料理が気に入ったらしい。
example_sentences.english: He seems to like the food at this ryokan more than he likes the onsen.

general_translation: On the way, Partway, In the middle of
formation: Verb［る］+ 途中（とちゅう） + で(1)Noun + の + 途中（とちゅう） + で(1)(1) に
casual_structure: Verb［る］+ 途中（とちゅう） + で(1)Noun + の + 途中（とちゅう） + で(1)(1) に
explanation: A common expression which an action in process, when (A) happens along the way, or in the middle of it.

example_sentences.japanese: シャッターがとちゅうで閉まらなくなってしまった。
example_sentences.english: The shutter unfortunately stopped closing in the middle (halfway).

example_sentences.japanese: 待ち合わせ場所に向かっているとちゅうに、「ごめん、やっぱり今日行けないかも」と友達からメールが来た。
example_sentences.english: On the way to the meeting place, I received a text from a friend saying, 'Sorry, I might not be able to make it today after all'.

example_sentences.japanese: 授業のとちゅうに校長先生から呼び出された時はビクッとした。
example_sentences.english: I was a bit startled when the principal called me out in the middle of class.

example_sentences.japanese: 会社から帰るとちゅうで変なおじさんに話しかけられた。
example_sentences.english: On my way home from work, a strange man tried to talk to me.

example_sentences.japanese: ミーティングのとちゅうで社長が倒れて、会社中がパニックになった。
example_sentences.english: The president collapsed in the middle of a meeting and everyone in the whole company panicked.

example_sentences.japanese: 集金のとちゅうでお釣りがなくなってしまった。
example_sentences.english: I lost the change partway through collecting money.

example_sentences.japanese: 面接のとちゅうでリクルーターはいきなり笑い始めた。
example_sentences.english: In the middle of an interview, the recruiter suddenly started laughing.

example_sentences.japanese: 朝ご飯を作っているとちゅうで電話が鳴った。
example_sentences.english: In the middle of making breakfast, the telephone rang.

example_sentences.japanese: シーズンのとちゅうで引退会見をするのは微妙だ。
example_sentences.english: Holding a retirement press conference in the middle of the season is questionable.

example_sentences.japanese: 会議の司会をしているとちゅうでトイレに行きたくなって困った。
example_sentences.english: I found myself in a pickle when I had to go to the bathroom in the middle of leading a meeting.

example_sentences.japanese: 出張のとちゅうに実家に寄ってもいいと言われた。
example_sentences.english: I was told that it was okay to stop by my parent's home in the middle of the business trip.

example_sentences.japanese: 受験のとちゅうにお腹が痛くなり、退席した。
example_sentences.english: In the middle of sitting an exam, my stomach started hurting and I left.

example_sentences.japanese: 旅のとちゅうで迷っていたら、通行人が案内してくれた。
example_sentences.english: In the middle of a trip, I lost my way, and a passerby gave me directions.

example_sentences.japanese: 習字のとちゅうにお菓子を食べる人なんていません。
example_sentences.english: There is no way there are people who eat snacks in the middle of practicing penmanship.

example_sentences.japanese: 出勤のとちゅうで電車が止まり、会社に遅刻してしまった。
example_sentences.english: The train stopped in the middle of going to work, and I was unfortunately late to work.

example_sentences.japanese: 集会のとちゅうに反対派の人たちが乱入してきた。
example_sentences.english: In the middle of the assembly, people from the opposing party barged in.

general_translation: In, On, Into, Inside of
formation: Noun + の + 中（なか）を
casual_structure: Noun + の + 中（なか）を
explanation: An expression which highlights the inside of (A) as being the surface or area for which (B) takes place.

example_sentences.japanese: トンネルのなかを覗く。
example_sentences.english: I will peer into a tunnel.

example_sentences.japanese: 家に帰ってきたら、まずは弁当箱のなかを空にしてっていつも言ってるじゃん！
example_sentences.english: I always tell you to empty out the inside of the lunch box first thing when you come home, don't I?

example_sentences.japanese: スーパーのなかを何も買わずにウロウロしていたら、警備員のおじさんに怪しまれて声をかけられた。
example_sentences.english: When I was wandering around (inside) the supermarket without buying anything, the security guard thought I was suspicious so he came to talk to me.

example_sentences.japanese: 鍋のなかを洗う。
example_sentences.english: I will wash the inside of a pot.

example_sentences.japanese: 家のなかを猫が駆け回っている。
example_sentences.english: The cat is running around the inside of the house.

example_sentences.japanese: ペットボトルのなかをちゃんと洗ってください。
example_sentences.english: Please wash the inside of the plastic bottle.

example_sentences.japanese: 人混みのなかを歩くのは大変です。
example_sentences.english: It is hard to walk within a crowd of people.

example_sentences.japanese: あの箱のなかを覗いてみたら、空っぽだった。
example_sentences.english: When I peeked into that box, I saw that it was empty.

example_sentences.japanese: 鳥かごのなかを少し改造してみた。
example_sentences.english: I tried remodeling a little the inside of the bird cage.

example_sentences.japanese: この水族館は、まるで海のなかを歩いているようだ。
example_sentences.english: This aquarium is like walking inside of the ocean.

example_sentences.japanese: 家のなかを自動で掃除してくれるロボットが流行っています。
example_sentences.english: Robots that automatically clean the inside of your house are popular.

example_sentences.japanese: 久々に車のなかを掃除できて良かった。
example_sentences.english: I am glad I was able to clean the inside of the car for the first time in a long time.

example_sentences.japanese: 心のなかを知られないように、いつもポーカーフェイスでいる。
example_sentences.english: So that you can't know what is going on inside of his mind, he always puts on a poker face.

example_sentences.japanese: スーパーのなかを行ったり来たりして、安い商品を探した。
example_sentences.english: He looked for cheap merchandise, going to and from inside of the supermarket.

example_sentences.japanese: 子供が妙に静かだな〜と思い、子供部屋のなかを覗いてみたらただ寝ていただけだった。
example_sentences.english: I thought, 'My kid is suspiciously quiet', so I peeked into their room, but they were just sleeping.

general_translation: Focused on, Centered on or around, Mainly, Most notably
formation: Noun + を中心（ちゅうしん） + に(1)Noun + を中心（ちゅうしん） + にした(2) + Noun(1) にして、として(2) とした
casual_structure: Noun + を中心（ちゅうしん） + に(1)Noun + を中心（ちゅうしん） + にした(2) + Noun(1) にして、として(2) とした
explanation: A phrase expressing that (A) is the focus or main point of something. (A) is the central heart of (B).

example_sentences.japanese: てるはしさんをちゅうしんに世界が回っている。
example_sentences.english: The world revolves mainly around Teruhashi-san.

example_sentences.japanese: あのアイドルは若者をちゅうしんに人気を集めている。
example_sentences.english: That idol is gaining popularity, mainly among young people.

example_sentences.japanese: 私は今日本語の文法をちゅうしんに勉強をしています。
example_sentences.english: Currently, I am focusing my studies on Japanese grammar.

example_sentences.japanese: 明日からは札幌をちゅうしんに大雪が降るところがあるでしょう。
example_sentences.english: There will be heavy snow in some areas, mainly in Sapporo, starting tomorrow.

example_sentences.japanese: この業界ではお客様をちゅうしんにすることが一番重要なことだと言われている。
example_sentences.english: It is said that the most important thing in this industry is to focus on the customers.

example_sentences.japanese: これからはクライアントの提案をちゅうしんにした話を進めたいと思います。
example_sentences.english: From now on, I would like to proceed with a focus on the client's proposal.

example_sentences.japanese: ここはスケートボードをちゅうしんにしたポップアップストアです。
example_sentences.english: This is a pop-up store focusing on skateboards.

example_sentences.japanese: 健康診断に行ったら先生に揚げ物をちゅうしんとする食生活はやめるようにと言われた。
example_sentences.english: When I went to my physical check-up, my doctor told me to stop centering my diet around fried food.

example_sentences.japanese: マコさんはコンピューターをちゅうしんとして生活をしている。
example_sentences.english: Mako leads a life centered around computers.

example_sentences.japanese: 妻は働き、私は育児をちゅうしんに生活しています。
example_sentences.english: My wife works and I place my focus on raising the children. That is our livelihood.

example_sentences.japanese: あのアンテナをちゅうしんに家を何軒か建てましょう。
example_sentences.english: Let's build some houses centered around that antenna.

example_sentences.japanese: 息子はあいかわらずお金をちゅうしんに物を考えているようだ。
example_sentences.english: As always, my son always thinks in terms that are focused on money.

example_sentences.japanese: 揚げ物をちゅうしんにした食生活は健康に悪い。
example_sentences.english: A diet consisting mainly of fried foods is bad for your health.

example_sentences.japanese: この町は運河をちゅうしんにして整備されていてとても綺麗だ。
example_sentences.english: This town most notably developed around the canal and is very beautiful.

example_sentences.japanese: いい加減宴会をちゅうしんにした生活はやめてください。
example_sentences.english: Please stop living your life focused on irresponsibly going out to parties.

example_sentences.japanese: 明け方をちゅうしんに創作活動をするのが僕には合っています。
example_sentences.english: The most suitable time for me to be productive is mainly at dawn.

example_sentences.japanese: アクセントをちゅうしんに練習していけば、日本語がさらに上手になりますよ。
example_sentences.english: You will get even better at Japanese if your practice is centered around (improving) your accent.

example_sentences.japanese: 打合せをちゅうしんに計画を立ててくれないと、話がなかなか先に進みません。
example_sentences.english: If you do not create a plan focused around the business meeting, we will not be able to readily proceed with the talks.

example_sentences.japanese: 天気予報：「明日は、九州をちゅうしんに雨の降る所があるでしょう。」
example_sentences.english: Weather forecast: 'Rain will fall mainly in Kyuushuu tomorrow.'

general_translation: Besides, In addition, Furthermore
formation: その上（うえ） + Phrase
casual_structure: その上（うえ） + Phrase
explanation: A formal sentence starter expressing when something is in addition to, or on top of that which was previously said.

example_sentences.japanese: 彼は勇ましい。そのうえ優しいのだから、言うことない。
example_sentences.english: He is brave. In addition, he is kind, so there isn't anything to say.

example_sentences.japanese: 高橋さんはとても頭がいい。そのうえ、人柄もいいので会社での評判がいいです。
example_sentences.english: Takahashi-san is very smart. Furthermore, he has a very good personality so he has a very good reputation in the company.

example_sentences.japanese: 今住んでいる家はものすごく小さい。そのうえ隣に住んでいる住人が一日中うるさいので、来月引っ越そうと思う。
example_sentences.english: The house I live in now is extremely small. In addition, the people who live next door are noisy all day long, so I'm thinking of moving out next month.

example_sentences.japanese: 今日は学校で先生に怒られた。そのうえ家に帰ったら親に怒られたのであまりいい一日ではなかった。
example_sentences.english: I was scolded by my teacher at school today. In addition, I was scolded by my parents when I came home, so it was not a very good day today.

example_sentences.japanese: 彼の家は薄暗い。そのうえ寒いから、冬場は悲惨だ。
example_sentences.english: His house is gloomy. Furthermore, it is cold, so winter time is terrible.

example_sentences.japanese: 顔が青白い。そのうえ、唇は紫だ。大丈夫だろうか？
example_sentences.english: His face is pale. Furthermore, his lips are purple. Is he okay, I wonder?

example_sentences.japanese: 彼は思い込みが激しい。そのうえ頑固だから、手に負えない。
example_sentences.english: His prejudices are intense. In addition, he is stubborn , so I can't manage him.

example_sentences.japanese: 彼は植木職人だ。そのうえパソコンのプログラムもできるなんて、すごい人だ。
example_sentences.english: He is a gardener. In addition, he is an impressive person who can do things like computer programming.

example_sentences.japanese: テスト勉強を怠った。そのうえ予想も外したから、結果は散々だ。
example_sentences.english: I neglected to study for the test. In addition, since my expectations were also off, the results were terrible.

example_sentences.japanese: 今日はとても寒かった。そのうえ、雨まで降ってきたので屋外のアルバイトは大変だった。
example_sentences.english: It was very cold today. In addition, it decided to rain so my outdoor part time job was really rough.

example_sentences.japanese: 荷物が多すぎる。そのうえ鞄自体も重いから、持つのが大変です。
example_sentences.english: I have too many bags. Furthermore, the bags themselves are heavy so carrying them is a pain.

example_sentences.japanese: あの人は意地悪だ。そのうえ口も悪いから付き合いたくない。
example_sentences.english: That person is ill-tempered. Furthermore, he has a dirty mouth so I don't want to associate with him.

example_sentences.japanese: あの店は安い。そのうえ回転も早くてすぐに座れるから、気軽に行ける。
example_sentences.english: That shop is cheap. In addition, the turnaround is quick and you can get a seat right away, so you can go there without worry.

example_sentences.japanese: 美味しいお料理をごちそうになってしまって。そのうえ、お土産までいただいて。本当に、ありがとうございます。
example_sentences.english: I was treated to some great food. Furthermore, I was also given a souvenir. Thank you so much!

example_sentences.japanese: 昨日は夜遅くまで編み物をしてしまった。そのうえ、朝早くから電話で起こされたのでとても眠いです。
example_sentences.english: I stayed up late last night knitting. Furthermore, I was woken up early by a phone call so I am really tired.

general_translation: Once, Since, Now that, As long as
formation: Verb［る］ + 上（うえ）はVerb［た］ + 上（うえ）は
casual_structure: Verb［る］ + 上（うえ）はVerb［た］ + 上（うえ）は
explanation: A formal grammar point which presents that upon, or above and beyond (A), (B) will also occur, or can be assumed.

example_sentences.japanese: かくなるうえはきさまを殺すしかない。今すぐ。
example_sentences.english: Since it has come to this, I have no choice but to kill you. Immediately.

example_sentences.japanese: 一人暮らしを始めたうえは、家事など料理は自分で全部やらなくてはいけない。
example_sentences.english: Now that I have started living alone, I must do all the housework and cooking on my own.

example_sentences.japanese: アイルランドに住むと決めたうえは、アイルランドの文化などを勉強しなければならない。
example_sentences.english: Now that I have decided to live in Ireland, I must study things such as Irish culture.

example_sentences.japanese: この会社の従業員として働くうえはきちんと我が社のルールを守ってもらわないと困ります。
example_sentences.english: As long as you are working as an employee of this company, we need you to follow our rules.

example_sentences.japanese: ワンちゃんを保護すると決めたからには、最後まで責任をもって育てなくてはいけない。
example_sentences.english: Now that you have decided to adopt a puppy, you must take responsibility and raise it until the end.

example_sentences.japanese: 十分な証拠がない以上は、彼を逮捕することができません。
example_sentences.english: Since we don't have sufficient evidence, we can't arrest him.

example_sentences.japanese: 何かをし始めるうえは正しくやらなければならない。
example_sentences.english: Once you start doing something, you have to do it properly.

example_sentences.japanese: 日本に来たうえは勉強するつもりです。
example_sentences.english: Now that I have come to Japan, I intend to study.

example_sentences.japanese: 卒業したうえはより大人らしくなるべきだ。
example_sentences.english: Now that I have graduated, I should act more like an adult.

example_sentences.japanese: 市長になったうえは住民のために何かをしてあげたいです。
example_sentences.english: Now that I am mayor, I want to do something for the citizens.

example_sentences.japanese: 保安官：「この町にいるうえは、法を破ってはいけません。」
example_sentences.english: Sheriff: 'Now that I am in this city, you must not break the law.'

example_sentences.japanese: 選挙に勝つと言ったうえは、最後まで頑張るつもりです。
example_sentences.english: Now that I have said 'I will win the election', I intend to do my best till the end.

example_sentences.japanese: 力の輪が我々の手中にあるうえは確実に破壊するべきである。
example_sentences.english: Now that the ring of power is in our hands, we should destroy it.

example_sentences.japanese: 血圧が上がり、肝機能も低下したうえは、なんらかの病気があるはずだ。
example_sentences.english: Since my blood pressure and liver functionality has gotten worse, I must have some sort of illness.

example_sentences.japanese: 子供が犬を飼ううえは、責任感を持たせて成長させなければならない。
example_sentences.english: Now that the child is raising a dog, they must take responsibility and mature.

example_sentences.japanese: 政治家の山本さんは選挙に勝つための約束を結ぶうえは守るべきだ。しかし、実際には必ずしもそうとは限らない。
example_sentences.english: Now that the politician, Yamamoto-san, made a promise in order to win elections, he should keep it. But in reality, it is not always the case.

example_sentences.japanese: ヨナ姫様！王族の最後の末裔であるうえは反乱軍に見つからないうちに城外へ脱出した方がいいですよ。
example_sentences.english: Princess Yona! Since you are the last of the royal family, you should flee the castle before you are found by the rebel army.

general_translation: Under, Under the supervision of, On the basis of
formation: Noun + のもとで(1)(1) もとに、もと
casual_structure: Noun + のもとで(1)(1) もとに、もと
explanation: A formal construction, showing that something is being done under (A). In regard to either the supervision or basis of (A).

example_sentences.japanese: ベジカと戦うためにそんゴツウはカエ王様のもとで修行した。
example_sentences.english: In order to battle with Vegika, Songotsu trained under King Kae.

example_sentences.japanese: こんな厳しい環境のもとで試料を採取できたのは皆様のおかげです。
example_sentences.english: Thanks to all of you, we were able to gather samples under such harsh conditions.

example_sentences.japanese: 先輩のもとで働けて光栄です！
example_sentences.english: It is my pleasure that I can work under you!

example_sentences.japanese: その行為はこの法律のもとで禁止されています。
example_sentences.english: That action is prohibited on the basis of this law.

example_sentences.japanese: 皆さんの協力のもと、このプロジェクトを無事に終えることができました。皆さんありがとうございました。
example_sentences.english: Under everyone's hard work, we were able to successfully complete this project. Thank you all.

example_sentences.japanese: 佐々木先輩のご指導のもと、企画書を作成しています。
example_sentences.english: I am creating a proposal, on the basis of Sasaki-senpai's guidance.

example_sentences.japanese: 叔父さんのもとで働いた３年間は、僕にとって宝物です。
example_sentences.english: The three years that I worked under my uncle were special to me.

example_sentences.japanese: 盤石な地盤のもとでの選挙だが、余裕というわけではない。
example_sentences.english: It's an election with a solid base beneath it, but that doesn’t mean there’s a comfortable margin. (under)

example_sentences.japanese: 優秀な講師のもとで実験をしていたから、いろいろなスキルが身につきました。
example_sentences.english: The experiments I performed under an excellent lecturer allowed me to master a number of skills.

example_sentences.japanese: 高い基準のもとで訓練を受けたから、その後の仕事が楽にこなせる。
example_sentences.english: Because you trained under (while being held to) high standards, the rest of the work you do will be a breeze.

example_sentences.japanese: 火山学者のもとで教えていただいた経験を活かした仕事がしたい。
example_sentences.english: I want to work somewhere that makes use of the things that I learned under a volcanologist.

example_sentences.japanese: 厳格な国王のもとで教育を受けたら、融通の利かない人間になってしまった。
example_sentences.english: The training (I) received under the strict king led (me) to become someone that lacks versatility.

example_sentences.japanese: 有名な書道家のもとで習字を勉強したが、私には素質がなかったらしい。
example_sentences.english: I studied penmanship under a famous calligrapher, but it appears that I do not have the makings of a calligrapher.

example_sentences.japanese: 厳しい環境のもとでの観測は本当に辛かった。でも、いい成果が得られました。
example_sentences.english: Doing observations under relentless circumstances was really difficult. However, the results I received made it worth it.

example_sentences.japanese: このエンジンは８０度以下という温度の条件のもとで少なくとも５万時間は継続的に稼働できる。
example_sentences.english: Under the condition that the temperature is lower than 80 degrees Celcius, this engine can operate non-stop for at least 50000 hours.

example_sentences.japanese: ある金属は一定の状態のもとに電気抵抗が急にゼロになる。そういう超伝導物質を英語では「superconductors」と呼ばれている。
example_sentences.english: The electrical resistance in certain metals suddenly falls to zero under specified conditions. Such super-conductive materials are called 'superconductors' in English.

example_sentences.japanese: あの職人のもとで働けば、技を盗めるのではないかと思っている。
example_sentences.english: If (you) work under that worker, I think that (you) will acquire some skills.

example_sentences.japanese: 沖縄は１９４５年から１９７２年までアメリカの統治下であった。
example_sentences.english: Okinawa was under the reign of America from 1945 to 1972.

example_sentences.japanese: その国は現在敵国の支配下にある。
example_sentences.english: Currently, that country is under the control of our enemy.

general_translation: …left, Rest, Remaining, In, …to, …else
formation: あと + の + Nounあと + Phraseあと + Number +（Counter)
casual_structure: あと + の + Nounあと + Phraseあと + Number +（Counter)
explanation: A phrase used to show the rest or remainder of (A). What's left after is (A).

example_sentences.japanese: 「次の電車はいつくるの？」「あと八分で来るよ。」
example_sentences.english: 'When is the next train coming?''It will be coming in eight minutes.' (after)

example_sentences.japanese: 今あなたが持っている段ボール箱はキッチンまで運んでおいてください。後の段ボール箱は全部寝室までお願いします。
example_sentences.english: Please bring the cardboard box you are carrying into the kitchen. Please take all the rest to the master bedroom.

example_sentences.japanese: 後ちょっとで着くからもうちょっと我慢して。
example_sentences.english: We will arrive in a little bit, so please be patient for a little longer.

example_sentences.japanese: 映画公開まで後三日！
example_sentences.english: Three days left until the movie gets released!

example_sentences.japanese: いすずちゃん：「この問題は私がやるわ。」かにえくん：「じゃあ、あとはこっちに任せてくれ。」
example_sentences.english: Isuzu: 'I will deal with this problem.'Kanie: 'If so, then leave the rest to me.' (remaining)

example_sentences.japanese: チトゲさん：「ラクさんが来るまで、あと何分？」オノデラさん：「まだあと五分！」
example_sentences.english: Chitoge: 'How many minutes left until Raku comes?'Onodera: 'Still 5 minutes left!' (remaining)

example_sentences.japanese: 彼女：「たまごと牛乳はあるの。」彼氏：「あとは何が必要なの？」
example_sentences.english: Girlfriend: 'We have eggs and milk.'Boyfriend: 'Do we need anything else?' (remaining)

example_sentences.japanese: ヨツバちゃん：「ミクとイツキは先に行ったわ。」フウタロウくん：「あとの連中は？」ヨツバちゃん：「全然わからないわ。」
example_sentences.english: Yotsuba: 'Miku and Itsuki went ahead.'Fuutarou: 'And the rest of the group?'Yotsuba: 'I have no idea.' (remaining)

example_sentences.japanese: ＳＦ映画：「ヨーロッパを除いて、あとの世界は全てあなた方のものだ。」
example_sentences.english: Sci-fi Movie: 'Except for Europa, the remaining worlds belong to you.'

example_sentences.japanese: 砂漠で独り言を言う：「ガソリンがあと７リットルしかない。足りるかな？」
example_sentences.english: Talking to oneself in the desert: 'There are only 7 liters of gasoline left. I wonder if it is enough?' (remaining)

example_sentences.japanese: 妻は夫と話している：「あと少ししか砂糖がないから、コンビニに買いに行ってくれない？」
example_sentences.english: A wife talking with her husband: 'Since there is only a little sugar left, won't you go to the convenience store and buy some?' (remaining)

example_sentences.japanese: 「日本語能力試験まであと３１日しかない、詰めて勉強しなきゃだ。」
example_sentences.english: 'There are only 31 days left until the JLPT, I have to focus and study.' (remaining)

example_sentences.japanese: お客様：「席を予約したいのですが、空席の数はどのくらいですか？」映画館の切符販売員：「あと三席です。」
example_sentences.english: Client: 'I would like to reserve some seats, how many do you have free??'Cinema attendant: 'There are three seats left.' (remaining)

example_sentences.japanese: 学生１：「明日は試験なのに、どうして一日中ゲームなんてしてたの！？」学生２：「うそっ！？試験まであと一日しかないなんて聞いてないよ！」
example_sentences.english: Student1: 'Why did you play games all day long even though there is an exam tomorrow?'Student2: 'No way! I didn't hear anything about having only one day left until the exam!' (remaining)

example_sentences.japanese: 兄弟が話している：「お父さんがお土産を買って来たよ。あなたに一つ、わたしに一つ。あとのものはお母さんにだよ。」
example_sentences.english: Siblings are talking: 'Father brought souvenirs. One for you, and one for me. The rest is for mom.' (remaining)

example_sentences.japanese: 子供がお隣さんと話している：「うちでは７匹動物を飼ってるんです。猫が５匹、あとの２匹は犬です。」
example_sentences.english: A child is talking with a neighbor: 'We have 7 animals at home. 5 are cats and the remaining ones are dogs.'

general_translation: Before, In front of, From one's standpoint or side
formation: Verb + 手前（てまえ）Noun + の + 手前（てまえ）
casual_structure: Verb + 手前（てまえ）Noun + の + 手前（てまえ）
explanation: An expression that highlights something as being in the forward facing viewpoint of (A), regardless of whether it is physical or mental.

example_sentences.japanese: あなたのてまえにあるものを見てください。
example_sentences.english: Please look at the thing that is in front of you.

example_sentences.japanese: 崖から落ちるてまえで父親に腕を引っ張られた。
example_sentences.english: My father pulled me by my arm before I fell off the cliff.

example_sentences.japanese: 勢いで手を上げてしまったてまえ、答えずに手を下げるわけにはいかない。
example_sentences.english: From the standpoint of me raising my hand in the heat of the moment, there is no way of me backing out without answering the question.

example_sentences.japanese: 先輩にはいつもお世話になっているてまえ、彼女の頼みを断るわけにはいかない。
example_sentences.english: Since my senpai always takes good care of me, there is no way that I can turn down her request.

example_sentences.japanese: 娘のてまえ、運動音痴な姿を見せるわけにはいかない。
example_sentences.english: I can't show my unathletic self in front of my daughter.

example_sentences.japanese: 彼女の両親のてまえ、発言には気を付けなければいけない。
example_sentences.english: I have to be careful of what I say when I am in front of my girlfriend's parents.

example_sentences.japanese: オルガンをもっとてまえに配置してください。
example_sentences.english: Please position the organ even more in front.

example_sentences.japanese: 死んでしまう一歩てまえで助かった。
example_sentences.english: I was helped just before I would have died. (on the brink)

example_sentences.japanese: 私のてまえの人が、私の友達です。
example_sentences.english: The person in front of me is my friend.

example_sentences.japanese: 火山の被害がうちのてまえまで及んだ。
example_sentences.english: The damage from the volcano extended to right in front of my house.

example_sentences.japanese: こちらに過失があったてまえ、強いことは言えません。
example_sentences.english: Our side made the mistake here, so we cannot complain. (we・this side)

example_sentences.japanese: 空っぽになるてまえでガソリンを入れることができた。
example_sentences.english: I was able to get gas before it became completely empty.

example_sentences.japanese: てまえの看板を撤去してください。
example_sentences.english: Please remove the sign in front.

example_sentences.japanese: 境界線のてまえで待っていてください。
example_sentences.english: Please wait in front of the boundary line.

example_sentences.japanese: これまでよりもてまえで曲がるカーブを投げられるようになった。
example_sentences.english: I became able to throw a curveball that curves even more in front.

example_sentences.japanese: てまえで警備している彼を交代させてください。
example_sentences.english: Please let me change places with the guy who is in front on defense.

example_sentences.japanese: 改札のてまえでスイカを忘れてきたことに気づいて良かった。
example_sentences.english: I am glad that, in front of the ticket gates, I noticed that I had forgotten my Suica (card).

general_translation: Concerning, In regard to, About, (Split) over
formation: Noun + をめぐって(1)Noun + をめぐる + Noun(1) をめぐり
casual_structure: Noun + をめぐって(1)Noun + をめぐる + Noun(1) をめぐり
explanation: A formal construction showing that something is in regard to (A). Encompassing the topic of (A).

example_sentences.japanese: 日本には金魚をめぐる戦いがある。
example_sentences.english: There is conflict in Japan over goldfish.

example_sentences.japanese: 隣人と土地の境界線をめぐってトラブルが起きた時は誰に連絡するべきですか？
example_sentences.english: Who should I contact if I have a problem with my neighbor concerning my property line?

example_sentences.japanese: この島をめぐる争いは私が生まれる前から続いています。
example_sentences.english: The conflict concerning this island has been going on since before I was born.

example_sentences.japanese: ゴミ出しルールをめぐってのトラブルはどの地域でも珍しいことではありません。
example_sentences.english: No matter the community, conflicts concerning garbage disposal rules are not uncommon.

example_sentences.japanese: あの組合せをめぐっては、やらせの疑いがある。
example_sentences.english: There is suspicion of a prearranged performance concerning that match (in a contest).

example_sentences.japanese: ファイルの形式をめぐる話し合いが今も続いています。
example_sentences.english: The discussion over the file format is still going on, even now.

example_sentences.japanese: 伝説の釜をめぐって、専門家たちが言い合いをしています。
example_sentences.english: The specialists are quarreling over the legendary iron pot.

example_sentences.japanese: 塩分の過剰摂取をめぐって、意見が分かれている。
example_sentences.english: Opinions are divided over the excessive consumption of salt.

example_sentences.japanese: 警備の仕方をめぐっての見解の相違が問題になっている。
example_sentences.english: The discrepancies in opinions over policing methods is currently a problem.

example_sentences.japanese: 伝統芸能をめぐって、流派間での争いがある。
example_sentences.english: There is conflict between the flower arrangement schools over the traditional performance.

example_sentences.japanese: 時代とともに、海賊王の宝が隠された場所をめぐる様々な論争が起こった。
example_sentences.english: As time passed, various disputes arose concerning the location of the hidden treasure of the pirate king.

example_sentences.japanese: 誰が担当するのか、人気の楽器をめぐっての争いが毎年ある。
example_sentences.english: Every year there is a contest to see who will be in charge in regards to the popular instrument.

example_sentences.japanese: 昇進をめぐって、加熱する接待攻勢がひどい状態になっている。
example_sentences.english: In regard to the promotion, the situation is very serious, with everyone in a heated attempt to be the most hospitable.

example_sentences.japanese: 今日、国会では増税するべきかそのまま据え置きするべきかをめぐって、激論が生じた。
example_sentences.english: There was a heated debate today over whether the parliament should raise taxes or leave them as they are.

example_sentences.japanese: スイスに於いて貿易協定をめぐり、米国とヨーロッパ連合の交渉が始まりました。
example_sentences.english: The negotiations between the United States and the European Union in regard to a trade agreement began in Switzerland today.

example_sentences.japanese: 数が限られている限定商品をめぐってお客様同士が言い合いになってしまった。
example_sentences.english: Customers argued with each other over a limited number of limited edition products.

example_sentences.japanese: 税金の使い方をめぐる議論から、内戦が始まってしまった。
example_sentences.english: A debate over the use of taxes has led to a civil war.

general_translation: Across, Throughout, Extends, Over (a period of time or range)
formation: Noun + にわたって(1)Noun + にわたる(2) + Noun(1) にわたり(2) にわたった
casual_structure: Noun + にわたって(1)Noun + にわたる(2) + Noun(1) にわたり(2) にわたった
explanation: A structure indicating that something spreads across (A), or traverses (A). May be in regard to a period of time or distance.

example_sentences.japanese: この車の細部にわたるこだわりはさすがですね。
example_sentences.english: The obsession over this car's details is impressive.

example_sentences.japanese: 彼は脱獄後長年にわたって警察から身を隠し続けた。
example_sentences.english: He continued to hide from the police for many years after his escape.

example_sentences.japanese: １５年にわたる戦争は、ついにその幕を閉じた。
example_sentences.english: A war that has been taking place for over fifteen years has finally come to its end.

example_sentences.japanese: 三日にわたって降り続いた雨がようやくやんだ。
example_sentences.english: The rain that continuously fell over three days has finally stopped.

example_sentences.japanese: ４０分にわたる校長先生の話が退屈だった。
example_sentences.english: The principal's speech that took place over 40 minutes was boring.

example_sentences.japanese: 長期にわたって利用してきたサービスが終了してしまう。
example_sentences.english: Unfortunately the service we have come to use over a long period of time will end.

example_sentences.japanese: 今日から７回にわたって、このテーマで授業を進めていきます。
example_sentences.english: From today, I am going to make progress on the class theme that will take place over seven classes.

example_sentences.japanese: 市役所は午後９時から翌午前６時にわたり閉館します。
example_sentences.english: City Hall will be closed over a period that extends from 9 p.m until 6 a.m the next day.

example_sentences.japanese: このタレは、何代にもわたって伝えられてきた秘伝の味です。
example_sentences.english: This sauce has a secret formula that has been passed down over many generations.

example_sentences.japanese: 過去１０年にわたる調査で分かったことを発表します。
example_sentences.english: I will present the findings from the investigation that took place over the past 10 years.

example_sentences.japanese: 理由は多岐にわたるので、１時間あっても説明しきれない。
example_sentences.english: Because the reason is wide-ranging, even if we had an hour, we couldn't finish the explanation.

example_sentences.japanese: 明日は北海道全域にわたって強い雪が降るでしょう。
example_sentences.english: Tomorrow, heavy snow will fall all across Hokkaido.

example_sentences.japanese: Ｃ１道路は雪により５キロにわたって通行できません。迂回路を使用してください。
example_sentences.english: The C1 is impassable over a range of 5 kilometers due to snow. Please use the detour.

example_sentences.japanese: 二か月にわたって開催された冬季オリンピックの閉会式が本日行われます。
example_sentences.english: The closing ceremony for the winter Olympics, held over the span of two months, will be carried out today.

example_sentences.japanese: 今朝に渡って行われた会議がようやく終わった。
example_sentences.english: The meeting that has been going on throughout the whole morning has finally ended.

example_sentences.japanese: 今晩に渡って落ち続けていたＡ社の株がやっと上がった。
example_sentences.english: The stock of Company A has finally risen after going down throughout tonight.

general_translation: Along, In accordance with, In line with
formation: Noun + にそってNoun + にそった(1) + Noun(1) にそう
casual_structure: Noun + にそってNoun + にそった(1) + Noun(1) にそう
explanation: A formal expression showing that (B) is in accordance with the convention of (A). Running alongside (A), (B).

example_sentences.japanese: スケジュールにそって作業を進めていきます。
example_sentences.english: I will continue operations in line with the schedule.

example_sentences.japanese: 会社のルールにそって、残業をする方は必ずタイムカードを押してからにしてください。
example_sentences.english: In accordance with company rules, please make sure to clock-in before you begin overtime.

example_sentences.japanese: クライアント様の希望にそう方向で進めたいと思います。
example_sentences.english: We would like to proceed in accordance with the client's wishes.

example_sentences.japanese: ご予算内でお客様のご希望にそったお家を建てれるよう全力を尽くします！
example_sentences.english: We will do our best to build you a home in accordance with your needs and within your budget!

example_sentences.japanese: この点線にそって切ってください。
example_sentences.english: Please cut along this dotted line.

example_sentences.japanese: この台本にそって司会してください。
example_sentences.english: Please lead the meeting in accordance with the script.

example_sentences.japanese: じゅうたんにそってしるしを付けるのはやめてほしい。
example_sentences.english: I want you to stop making marks along the carpet.

example_sentences.japanese: 提示した資料にそってチェックを進めてください。
example_sentences.english: Please continue the check in accordance with the presented materials.

example_sentences.japanese: 「道にそっていったら、そのうちスーパーが見えてきますよ」
example_sentences.english: 'If you go along the street, the supermarket will eventually come into view'.

example_sentences.japanese: 防犯のため、敷地にそって高い壁を作った。
example_sentences.english: In order to prevent crime, (they) built a high wall along the site.

example_sentences.japanese: このサンプルにそって作れば大抵の人はうまくできます。
example_sentences.english: If they make it in accordance with this sample, most people can do it well.

example_sentences.japanese: マニュアルにそって申請書を精査するのが私の仕事です。
example_sentences.english: My job is carefully examining written applications in accordance with the manual.

example_sentences.japanese: クライアントの希望にそった新製品を開発する予定です。
example_sentences.english: We plan on developing new products in line with our clients' expectations.

example_sentences.japanese: 先生！時間割にそって授業を進めた方がいいと思います。
example_sentences.english: Teacher! I think that it would be better to continue the class in line with the class schedule.

example_sentences.japanese: 新幹線の駅にそって新しい店がどんどん建っている。
example_sentences.english: New shops are popping up everywhere along the station with the bullet train.

example_sentences.japanese: マニュアル：「従業員は火災の際、避難計画にそってスーパーの前に集まること。」
example_sentences.english: Manual: 'In case of fire, the employees should gather in front of the supermarket in accordance with the evacuation plan.'

general_translation: After, As a conclusion of
formation: Verb［た］+ すえ （に）Noun + の + すえ （に）
casual_structure: Verb［た］+ すえ （に）Noun + の + すえ （に）
explanation: An expression highlighting that as a conclusion of (A), (B). On the tip of (A)'s completion (B). Regularly indicating effort to reach completion.

example_sentences.japanese: 温泉をほりあてたすえに、旅館を建てることにした。
example_sentences.english: After (much) digging to reveal the onsen, I decided to build a ryokan.

example_sentences.japanese: 色々と考えたすえに、お父さんの会社を継ぐことに決めた。
example_sentences.english: After much thought, I decided to take over my father's company.

example_sentences.japanese: 迷いに迷ったすえに、彼女と別れることにした。
example_sentences.english: After much hesitation, I decided to break up with her.

example_sentences.japanese: ５年間にわたる争いのすえ、アメリカ軍が撤退を開始した。
example_sentences.english: After five years of conflict, the U.S. military began to withdraw.

example_sentences.japanese: 社長と長い議論のすえに、人事の伊藤さんをクビにすることに決めた。
example_sentences.english: After a long discussion with the president, we decided to fire Ito-san from human resources.

example_sentences.japanese: これは、蚊にさされたすえの感染症です。
example_sentences.english: This is an infectious disease that arises after being bitten by a mosquito.

example_sentences.japanese: いろいろ面接したすえに、大企業に雇われたんだ。
example_sentences.english: After (doing) many interviews, I was hired by a big company.

example_sentences.japanese: あの人は、散々おそわったすえに仕事をやめてしまった。
example_sentences.english: That person, after being thoroughly taught (continuously), unfortunately quit.

example_sentences.japanese: 無理をして試合にでたすえに、大怪我をしてしまった。
example_sentences.english: After going (all out) into the match without listening to my body, I ended up getting severely injured.

example_sentences.japanese: 彼女と長い議論のすえに、来年の６月、結婚することに決めた。
example_sentences.english: After a (long) discussion with my girlfriend, we have decided to get married next June.

example_sentences.japanese: 頭が痛かったせいで眠れない夜をすごしたすえ、医者に診てもらおうと決めた。
example_sentences.english: After spending a (long) sleepless night due to a headache, I decided to see a doctor.

example_sentences.japanese: 消費税をあげたすえに不況になったら本末転倒だ。
example_sentences.english: After the (continuous) increase of the consumption tax, if there is a recession the government will have mistaken the insignificant with the essential.

example_sentences.japanese: 憲法改正のすえに、戦争に参加したりしなければいいのだが…
example_sentences.english: After (much work on) the constitutional reform, one does not have to participate in the war, but...

example_sentences.japanese: 衆議院解散のすえの選挙だが、そもそもの解散理由が微妙だ。
example_sentences.english: As for the election concluding the dissolution of the lower house of parliament, no one really knows why it was broken up in the first place.

example_sentences.japanese: 大学卒業後どうしようかとなやんだすえ、ベンチャー企業を立ち上げることにした。
example_sentences.english: After (continuously) worrying about what to do after graduation, I decided to start a business.

example_sentences.japanese: 散々思考を巡らせたすえに、ようやく銃を壁にかけて普通の生活を送りはじめた。
example_sentences.english: After (continuously) stewing on it, he was finally able to hang up his gun and begin an ordinary life.

general_translation: As, Following, As then, According to, In accordance with
formation: Verb［る］+ にしたがって(1)Noun + にしたがって(1)(1) にしたがい
casual_structure: Verb［る］+ にしたがって(1)Noun + にしたがって(1)(1) にしたがい
explanation: A formal phrase used to say something is done in compliance with (A), or following the lead of (A).

example_sentences.japanese: この原稿にしたがってインタビューに答えてください。
example_sentences.english: Please answer the interview in accordance with this manuscript.

example_sentences.japanese: 年を取るにしたがって、目がどんどん悪くなっていってる気がする。
example_sentences.english: I feel like my eyes are getting worse and worse as I get older.

example_sentences.japanese: テレワークの普及が進むにしたがって、通勤するサラリーマンが減っていっている。
example_sentences.english: As teleworking becomes more widespread, the number of office workers commuting to work is decreasing.

example_sentences.japanese: 僕はただ上司の指示にしたがって仕事を進めていただけです。
example_sentences.english: I was just following my boss' instructions to get the job done.

example_sentences.japanese: この説明書にしたがって、パソコンの初期設定を行ってください。
example_sentences.english: Please follow these instructions to perform the initial setup of your computer.

example_sentences.japanese: 憲法にしたがって、新たな法律が成立する。
example_sentences.english: In accordance with the constitution, the new law will be established.

example_sentences.japanese: クラスメイトの言うことにしたがって意地悪をしてはいけません。
example_sentences.english: You must not act unkindly in accordance with what your classmates say.

example_sentences.japanese: この足跡にしたがって進めば、きっとみんなに会えるはずです。
example_sentences.english: If you progress in accordance with these tracks, you will surely be able to see everyone.

example_sentences.japanese: 会社の指示にしたがってオートメーション化を進めています。
example_sentences.english: The change to automation is progressing according to the company's specifications.

example_sentences.japanese: 世界中でのインターネットの広がりにしたがい、情報へのアクセスは前よりもっと容易になる。
example_sentences.english: As the internet spreads all over the world, access to information becomes easier than before.

example_sentences.japanese: 歳をとるにしたがって、だんだんいいアイデアが思い浮かばなくなっているような気がする。
example_sentences.english: I have a feeling that, as I age, good ideas are gradually stopping coming to mind.

example_sentences.japanese: 有名な育児本にしたがって子供を育てたからといって、必ずうまくいくとは限らない。
example_sentences.english: Just because you raise a child in accordance with a famous book on child rearing, it won't necessarily always turn out well.

example_sentences.japanese: 勇ましい先人たちの手本にしたがって、我々も戦おうではないか！
example_sentences.english: In accordance with the model of our brave ancestors, let's fight!

example_sentences.japanese: 引力にしたがって生活するのはもう嫌だ。自由に空を飛びたい。
example_sentences.english: I hate living in accordance with gravity. I want to fly freely in the sky.

example_sentences.japanese: 指揮者の方針にしたがって演奏できないというのであれば、このオーケストラから出て行ってもらうしかない。
example_sentences.english: There is no choice but to have you leave this orchestra if you cannot perform according to the conductor's direction.

example_sentences.japanese: 年が経つにしたがって、非再生可能資源が枯渇する一方だ。
example_sentences.english: As years pass by, non-renewable resources continue to run out.

general_translation: As, Due,  Along with, Hand-in-hand with, Resulted in, Be consequent upon
formation: Verb［る］+（の）+ に伴（ともな）って(1)Verb［る］+（の）+ に伴（ともな）う + NounNoun + に伴（ともな）って(1)Noun + に伴（ともな）う + Noun(1) に伴（ともな）い
casual_structure: Verb［る］+（の）+ に伴（ともな）って(1)Verb［る］+（の）+ に伴（ともな）う + NounNoun + に伴（ともな）って(1)Noun + に伴（ともな）う + Noun(1) に伴（ともな）い
explanation: A structure which shows that (B) goes hand-in-hand with (A), or accompanies (A). (B) is often caused by or naturally follows (A).

example_sentences.japanese: 春が始まるにともなって、植生は復活する。
example_sentences.english: With the beginning of spring, the vegetation returns. (along with・consequent upon)

example_sentences.japanese: この町の人口が減少するにともなって空き家が増加して来ました。
example_sentences.english: As the population of this town has declined, the number of vacant houses has increased.

example_sentences.japanese: パソコンの初期化をするのにともなう手順は取扱説明書の５１ページに記載されています。
example_sentences.english: The procedure associated with formatting the computer is described on page 51 of the instruction manual.

example_sentences.japanese: インターネットの普及にともなって、オンラインで買い物を済ませる人が増えた。
example_sentences.english: With the spread of the Internet, more and more people are completing their purchases online.

example_sentences.japanese: 高速道路の情報サイト：リフレッシュ工事にともなう車線規制のお知らせ。
example_sentences.english: Highway information website: Notice of lane restriction due to road reconstruction.

example_sentences.japanese: 津波は地震にともない発生することが多いが、火山現象に伴い津波が発生することも有るそうだ。
example_sentences.english: Oftentimes, tsunami occur due to earthquakes, but apparently they can also occur due to volcanic phenomenon.

example_sentences.japanese: 歳を取るにともなって物忘れが酷くなってきてる感じがする。
example_sentences.english: I feel like I'm getting more forgetful as I get older.

example_sentences.japanese: 医学の進歩にともなって平均寿命が伸びています。
example_sentences.english: Along with the advancement of medical sciences, the average life expectancy is increasing.

example_sentences.japanese: 円高にともない輸出の量は減る。
example_sentences.english: As the value of the yen rises, the volume of export decreases. (along with・consequent upon)

example_sentences.japanese: 火傷にともなう痛みは神経への刺激が原因だとされている。
example_sentences.english: Pain associated with burns is considered to be caused by nerve stimulation.

example_sentences.japanese: 城の改修中、床の修理にともなって、壁も塗りなおされた。
example_sentences.english: During the castle renovation, along with the floor repairs, the walls were also repainted.

example_sentences.japanese: このゲームでは高レベルに達するにともなって、上級の魔法が使えるようになる。
example_sentences.english: In this game, as higher levels are reached, advanced magic will become available. (along with・consequent upon)

example_sentences.japanese: トマトはヨーロッパに初めて紹介されたときは、毒があると考えられていた。時が経つにともないこの野菜に対する考え方が変わってきた。
example_sentences.english: Tomatoes were considered to be poisonous when introduced to Europe for the first time. As time has passed, the way of thinking about this vegetable has come to change. (along with・consequent upon)

example_sentences.japanese: 動物性油脂の高摂取にともなう高コレステロール化は最近の研究で反証をあげて否定された。
example_sentences.english: High cholesterol associated with high intake of animal fats and oils has been disproven by a recent study.

example_sentences.japanese: 中国では野生ミツバチの生存数が少なくなるにともなって、農家が手作業で作物を受粉することを強制されています。
example_sentences.english: In China, as the number of surviving wild bees decreases, farmers are compelled to pollinate the crops manually. (along with・consequent upon)

example_sentences.japanese: ライト兄弟による初めての飛行は１９０３年に成された。それにともなって、近代の航空産業が生まれた。
example_sentences.english: The Wright brothers succeeded in becoming the first in flight in 1903. This resulted in the birth of the modern aviation industry. (along with・consequent upon)

example_sentences.japanese: 会社の階層構造では昇進にともない給与が上がっていくが、それと共に新しい業務も追加される。
example_sentences.english: In the company's hierarchical structure, salaries increase with promotions, but at the same time, new duties are added. (consequent upon)

example_sentences.japanese: 日本で起こった資産価格の上昇のバブル景気は１９９９年初めの時点でバーストした。それにともなって「失われた１０年」と呼ばれる金融危機の時代が始まった。
example_sentences.english: The asset prices bubble that occurred in Japan burst at the beginning of 1999. Along with this started the financial crisis period referred to as 'the lost decade'.

general_translation: Due to, On account of, Each or every
formation: Noun + につき
casual_structure: Noun + につき
explanation: A structure showing that something is due to (A), or for each (A). May be interpreted as taking up the position of (A), (B).

example_sentences.japanese: 工事中につき、迂回してください。
example_sentences.english: Due to construction, please take a detour.

example_sentences.japanese: 閉店につき、特別セール開催中！
example_sentences.english: Due to our store closing, there is a special sale going on!

example_sentences.japanese: 工事中につき、この先立ち入り禁止。
example_sentences.english: Due to construction, entry beyond this point is prohibited.

example_sentences.japanese: この商品は大人気のため、一人につき二つまでとさせていただいております。
example_sentences.english: Since this product is very popular, we are limiting it to two per person.

example_sentences.japanese: 開店につき、事務員を募集する。
example_sentences.english: On account of opening a new shop, we are hiring clerks.

example_sentences.japanese: 今なら１００円につき５ポイントもらえる。
example_sentences.english: Right now, you get five points for each 100 yen you spend.

example_sentences.japanese: 明日は祭日につき、会社は休みです。
example_sentences.english: On account of tomorrow's festival, the company will be closed.

example_sentences.japanese: ここは私有地につき、通り抜け禁止です。
example_sentences.english: Due to this being private land, it is prohibited to cut through here.

example_sentences.japanese: 本日は雨天につき、試合は中止となりました。
example_sentences.english: On account of today's rain, the match has been canceled.

example_sentences.japanese: 本日特売のたまごは、一人につき２パックまでです。
example_sentences.english: Today's special sale on eggs is limited to two cartons per person (each person).

example_sentences.japanese: 料理長の出張につき、本日はメニューを変更させていただきました。
example_sentences.english: On account of the head chef being on a business trip, today's menu has been changed.

example_sentences.japanese: この駐車場は３０分につき３００円も取られる。
example_sentences.english: This parking area takes as much as 300 yen for (every) 30 minutes.

example_sentences.japanese: 好評につき、期間限定でしたが定番メニューになりました。
example_sentences.english: On account of its popularity, the limited time item was made a standard menu item.

example_sentences.japanese: 熱中症アラートの発令につき、ケイティ・シェリーのコンサートがキャンセルされました。ご迷惑をおかけして申し訳ありません。
example_sentences.english: Due to the heat stroke alert's announcement, Katy Sherry's concert has been canceled. We are sorry for the inconvenience.

example_sentences.japanese: 改築工事中につき、２階のお手洗をご使用ください。ご迷惑をおかけして申し訳ありません。
example_sentences.english: Due to ongoing renovation works, please use the restroom on the second floor. We are sorry for the inconvenience.

general_translation: Whenever, Every time something happens
formation: Verb［る］+ につけ（て）Noun + につけ（て）
casual_structure: Verb［る］+ につけ（て）Noun + につけ（て）
explanation: A formal, old-fashioned expression indicating that whenever (A) happens, (B) adheres to that and also happens.

example_sentences.japanese: 話し合いをするにつけ、喧嘩ばかりしてしまう。
example_sentences.english: Whenever we have a discussion, unfortunately we end up only fighting.

example_sentences.japanese: 元カノが写っている写真を見るにつけ、胸が痛くなる。
example_sentences.english: Every time I see a picture with my ex-girlfriend, my heart aches.

example_sentences.japanese: この防波堤で釣りをするにつけ、父親のことを思い出す。
example_sentences.english: Every time I fish on this breakwater, it reminds me of my father.

example_sentences.japanese: 彼は何かにつけ文句を言うので、一緒にいるだけで疲れる。
example_sentences.english: Since he complains whenever anything happens, it's exhausting being around him.

example_sentences.japanese: 妻は妊娠中なので悲しい思いをしたり嬉しい思いをしたりするにつけ、すぐに泣き出します。
example_sentences.english: Since my wife is pregnant, she immediately bursts out crying whenever she has sad or happy experiences.

example_sentences.japanese: あの時先輩に言われた事を思い出すにつけて、怒りが込み上がってきます。
example_sentences.english: Every time I remember what my senpai said to me, I get filled with anger.

example_sentences.japanese: 彼と一緒に時間を過ごすにつけて、なんでこんな人と付き合っているんだろうと思う。
example_sentences.english: Every time I spend time with him, I think to myself, 'why am I still dating such a person'.

example_sentences.japanese: この絵を見るにつけ、子供の頃のことを思い出す。
example_sentences.english: Every time I see this picture, I recall my childhood.

example_sentences.japanese: 悪い噂を聞くにつけて、だんだん不安になってきた。
example_sentences.english: Every time I hear a bad rumor, I gradually become anxious.

example_sentences.japanese: 雨につけ雪につけ、どうせ仕事には行かなければならない。
example_sentences.english: Whenever it rains, whenever it snows, I somehow have to go to work.

example_sentences.japanese: 隣の叔父さんは何かにつけて文句を言う人だ。
example_sentences.english: The old man next door is a person who complains whenever something (anything) happens.

example_sentences.japanese: サークルに顔を出すにつけ、なぜか緊張してしまう。
example_sentences.english: Whenever I show up at club activities, I get nervous for some reason.

example_sentences.japanese: 彼と関わるにつけて、その優しさに心が和む。
example_sentences.english: Whenever I interact with him, his kindness puts me at ease.

example_sentences.japanese: 高校の時の制服を見るにつけ、あの時の楽しさを思い出す。
example_sentences.english: Every time I see my uniform from my high school days, I suddenly recall how much fun I had at that time.

example_sentences.japanese: アグネスからの茶碗を見るにつけて、一緒に居て、平和な日々を懐かしく感じる。
example_sentences.english: Whenever I see the teacup from Agness, I feel nostalgic for our peaceful days together.

example_sentences.japanese: 息子からの便りが届くにつけ、日々成長しているのがよく分かる。
example_sentences.english: Whenever news about my son arrives, I fully understand that he is growing day by day.

example_sentences.japanese: 会社の実情を知るにつけ、入社したことを後悔する人が続出しています。
example_sentences.english: Whenever the people who joined the company become aware of the company's circumstances, one after another they regret it.

example_sentences.japanese: 私は昔から古い写真にとても興味があった。写真を見るにつけ、撮られた人は誰なのか、後にどんな生活を送っていたのかなど疑問に思う。
example_sentences.english: Since long ago, I have been interested in old pictures. Whenever I see a photo, I wonder who the people are, what kind of life they led, etc.

general_translation: To relate to, To have to do with, Concerning, Depends on
formation: Noun + にかかわるNoun + にかかわる + Noun
casual_structure: Noun + にかかわるNoun + にかかわる + Noun
explanation: A phrase expressing being linked to (A), to show that (B) is concerning or about (A).

example_sentences.japanese: 医師は命にかかわる仕事です。
example_sentences.english: A doctor's job has to do with life.

example_sentences.japanese: あの試験は私の人生にかかわるので、一生懸命勉強しなくてはならない。
example_sentences.english: ​​I have to study hard for that exam because my life depends on it.

example_sentences.japanese: 別に命にかかわる病気では無いので、すぐに治療する必要はないです。
example_sentences.english: This is not a disease that will affect your life, so there's no need to treat it immediately.

example_sentences.japanese: この面接は私の人生にかかわるので、頑張らなければいけない。
example_sentences.english: This interview concerns my life, so I must do my best.

example_sentences.japanese: そのファイルにはお客様にかかわる大切な情報が記載されているので何があっても絶対無くさないようにしてください。
example_sentences.english: That file contains important information concerning our customers, so please do not lose it at all costs.

example_sentences.japanese: 判事の行動は司法の信用にかかわる。
example_sentences.english: The actions of judges are connected to trust in the legal system.

example_sentences.japanese: 会社の存亡にかかわる危機に直面している。
example_sentences.english: We are confronting crises that have to do with the life and death of the company.

example_sentences.japanese: わたしの将来にかかわる面接だから、重要なんです。
example_sentences.english: Since this is an interview that has to do with my future, it is important.

example_sentences.japanese: 人間関係にかかわる問題はなかなか難しい。
example_sentences.english: Problems concerning human relations are rather difficult.

example_sentences.japanese: それは家族にかかわる問題だから、一人では決められません。
example_sentences.english: Since that is a problem that has to do with the family, I cannot decide alone.

example_sentences.japanese: この商品の成功はわが社の将来にかかわることだ。
example_sentences.english: The future of our company depends on this product's success.

example_sentences.japanese: 私の約束を守らないと私の沽券にかかわるよ。
example_sentences.english: My reputation depends on keeping my promise. (If I do not keep my promise, my reputation will be affected)

example_sentences.japanese: これは夫婦関係にかかわる話です。ちゃんと奥さんと話し合ってください。
example_sentences.english: This is a conversation that has to do with your relationship. Please discuss it properly with your wife.

example_sentences.japanese: 規制を実施するのはビットコインの市場の浮沈にかかわる問題だ。
example_sentences.english: The rise and fall of the Bitcoin market depends on the enforcement of its regulation.

example_sentences.japanese: これは法律にかかわる問題ですから、慎重に検討しましょう。
example_sentences.english: Since this is a problem concerning the law, let's consider it with care.

example_sentences.japanese: 父は来週、命にかかわるような大きな手術を受ける。いつも父の体が気がかりだ。
example_sentences.english: My father has a life-threatening (concerning his life) operation next week. He is always on my mind.

example_sentences.japanese: このツールの使い方にかかわる質問はありますか？
example_sentences.english: Do you have any questions that have to do with how to use this tool? (Unnatural Japanese)

example_sentences.japanese: このツールの使い方に関する質問はありますか？
example_sentences.english: Do you have any questions concerning how to use this tool? (Natural Japanese)

general_translation: Towards, To face, To head to
formation: Noun + に向（む）かってNoun + に向（む）けてNoun + に向（む）けて + の + Noun
casual_structure: Noun + に向（む）かってNoun + に向（む）けてNoun + に向（む）けて + の + Noun
explanation: An expression usually used with nouns, indicating that (A) is heading or facing in a certain direction.

example_sentences.japanese: カメラにむかって、笑顔をお願いします。
example_sentences.english: Please face the camera and smile.

example_sentences.japanese: マイクにむかって何か一言お願いします。
example_sentences.english: Please face the mic and say something.

example_sentences.japanese: 空にむかって大声を出した。
example_sentences.english: I shouted loudly towards the sky.

example_sentences.japanese: 明るい未来にむかって一緒に人生を歩もうじゃ無いか！
example_sentences.english: Why don't we walk toward a bright future together!

example_sentences.japanese: 新入社員にむけて何かアドバイスを一言お願いします。
example_sentences.english: Please share a few words of advice suitable for the new employees.

example_sentences.japanese: 彼らは全国大会にむけて毎日朝から夜までトレーニングをしている。
example_sentences.english: They are training towards the national championship from morning to night everyday.

example_sentences.japanese: 受験生にむけてアドバイスをお願いします。
example_sentences.english: Please give some advice aimed at a student preparing for exams.

example_sentences.japanese: 日本をはじめ、外国にむけてブランドを広げたい。
example_sentences.english: Starting with Japan, I want to expand my brand towards foreign countries.

example_sentences.japanese: 通貨統一にむけての動きが加速している。
example_sentences.english: The movement toward the unification of currency is accelerating.

example_sentences.japanese: 深夜のアルバイトにむけて昼寝をしておこう。
example_sentences.english: Aiming toward my late night part time job, I am going to take a nap in advance.

example_sentences.japanese: 扇風機にむかって話すとおもしろい声になります。
example_sentences.english: If you speak facing an electric fan, it will make a funny voice.

example_sentences.japanese: 創作活動にむけて情報収集をしてください。
example_sentences.english: Please gather information aimed at creative activities.

example_sentences.japanese: 将来にむかって、治療の発展は進む一方だ。
example_sentences.english: Heading toward the future, medical development is continuously progressing.

example_sentences.japanese: 長男にむかって説教をしたが、あれは他の子供達にも伝えたいことだった。
example_sentences.english: The speech was aimed at the eldest son, but was something I want to share with the other kids.

example_sentences.japanese: 小学生にむかってなんでそんなに難しい言い方をするのだろう...
example_sentences.english: I wonder why he uses such a difficult way of speaking toward elementary school students.

example_sentences.japanese: 進路相談の日にむけて、いろいろと学校の資料を調べています。
example_sentences.english: Aiming toward career consultation day, I am looking up various schools' materials.

example_sentences.japanese: 放火が続いているが、消防署にむかって文句を言っても仕方ない。
example_sentences.english: Because the arsons continue, even if you complain to (at/toward) the fire department, there is nothing they can do.

general_translation: To be interested in, To be concerned about
formation: Noun + が気（き）になるVerb + こと(1) + が気（き）になる(1) の
casual_structure: Noun + が気（き）になるVerb + こと(1) + が気（き）になる(1) の
polite_structure: Noun + が気（き）になりますVerb + こと(1) + が気（き）になります(1) の
explanation: A phrase that highlights when (A) has become the focus of attention or interest.

example_sentences.japanese: あの工場見学がきになる。
example_sentences.english: I am interested in taking a tour of that factory.

example_sentences.japanese: 家自体は良いと思うんですけど、やっぱり値段がきになります。なんでこんなに安いんですか？
example_sentences.english: I think the house itself is nice, however I am concerned about the price. Why is it so cheap?

example_sentences.japanese: 私は高橋さんがきになる。
example_sentences.english: I am interested in Takahashi-san.

example_sentences.japanese: やっぱりお前がさっき言ったことがきになる。
example_sentences.english: I am still concerned about what you said earlier.

example_sentences.japanese: 私は好きな人の考えていることがきになる。
example_sentences.english: I am interested in what the person I like is thinking about.

example_sentences.japanese: 最近、芸能界がきになる。
example_sentences.english: Recently, I have become interested in the entertainment world.

example_sentences.japanese: あの映画がきになっている。あらすじだけは知っているけど。
example_sentences.english: I am interested in that movie. I only know the summary of it though.

example_sentences.japanese: この香水を付けている人がきになる。
example_sentences.english: I am interested in people who wear this perfume. (concerned with)

example_sentences.japanese: クッキーよりもその入れ物がきになっている。すごくかわいいから。
example_sentences.english: I am even more interested in the box than the cookies. It is so cute!

example_sentences.japanese: 新商品の売行きがきになる。
example_sentences.english: I am concerned with the demand of the new product.

example_sentences.japanese: あの人がいつも食べているおやつがきになる。
example_sentences.english: I am concerned about the snacks that that person is always eating.

example_sentences.japanese: 大好きな選手がいつも噛んでいるガムのメーカーがきになる。
example_sentences.english: I am interested in who makes the gum that my favorite athlete always chews.

example_sentences.japanese: この足跡がきになる。もしかしたら熊の足跡かもしれません。
example_sentences.english: I am concerned about these tracks. It is possible that they are bear tracks.

example_sentences.japanese: 友達の日本語のアクセントがきになる。出身はどこなんだろう…
example_sentences.english: I am interested in my friend's Japanese accent. I wonder where he is from.

example_sentences.japanese: 最近発売された珍しい魚の缶詰がきになっているんです。
example_sentences.english: I am interested in a canned fish that is rare and was recently put on sale.

example_sentences.japanese: あの人の言い方がいちいちきになる。上から目線だからだと思う。
example_sentences.english: I am concerned about that person's way of speaking. I think that it is because they are talking from a superior's standpoint.

example_sentences.japanese: 私が気にすることは彼が良い人かどうかだけです。
example_sentences.english: All I care about is whether he is a good person or not.

example_sentences.japanese: 私がきになることは彼が良い人かどうかだけです。
example_sentences.english: The only thing that I am concerned about is whether he is a good person or not.

general_translation: Take care, Be careful, Pay attention, Make sure, Watch out
formation: Noun + に気（き）をつけるVerb［ない］+ ように気（き）をつける
casual_structure: Noun + に気（き）をつけるVerb［ない］+ ように気（き）をつける
polite_structure: Noun + に気（き）をつけますVerb［ない］+ ように気（き）をつけます
explanation: A phrase used for giving warnings, or to advise care, literally by telling someone to attach their attention to (A).

example_sentences.japanese: 頭をぶつけないようにシャッターにきをつけよう。
example_sentences.english: Let's be careful not to bump our head on the shutter.

example_sentences.japanese: 最近、電車に痴漢が沢山いるらしいから怪しい人にきをつけて帰ってくるんだよ。
example_sentences.english: I hear there are a lot of perverts on the trains these days, so watch out for suspicious people on your way back home.

example_sentences.japanese: 車で歩道を横切る時には歩行者にきをつけましょう。
example_sentences.english: Be careful of pedestrians when you drive through a sidewalk.

example_sentences.japanese: このギターは俺の姉ちゃんのやつだから壊さないようにきをつけてね。
example_sentences.english: This guitar belongs to my sister, so please be careful not to break it.

example_sentences.japanese: 今月はお金を無駄遣いしないようにきをつけよう。
example_sentences.english: This month, I will be careful not to waste money.

example_sentences.japanese: 電柱にきをつけて車庫入れをしてください。
example_sentences.english: Please watch out for the telephone poles when parking.

example_sentences.japanese: 氷は滑りやすいから、足もとにきをつけて。
example_sentences.english: The ice is slippery, so please watch your step.

example_sentences.japanese: 妊娠中の女性は、健康にきをつけるべきだ。
example_sentences.english: Pregnant women should be careful of their health.

example_sentences.japanese: 階段は急だから、落ちないようにきをつけなさい。
example_sentences.english: Since the stairs are steep, take care not to fall.

example_sentences.japanese: 通りを横切る時には、車にきをつけて。
example_sentences.english: When you are crossing the street, watch out for cars.

example_sentences.japanese: 言葉にきをつけよ！先生としてふさわしくない行動だ！
example_sentences.english: Watch your language! Your behavior is unbecoming of a teacher!

example_sentences.japanese: あの家に住むなら、湿気にきをつけた方がいいです。
example_sentences.english: If you are going to live in that house, it would be better to be careful of humidity.

example_sentences.japanese: 土地を買うなら地盤にきをつけて選ぼう。
example_sentences.english: If we are going to buy land, let's make our decision while paying attention to the ground (where we will build).

example_sentences.japanese: 締切にきをつけて作業していたのに間に合わなかった。
example_sentences.english: Despite working while being careful of the deadline, I didn't make it in time. (carefully)

example_sentences.japanese: あのパソコンは、弱点にきをつけて使えばすごい威力を発揮する。
example_sentences.english: If you use that PC while taking into account its shortcomings, it is capable of amazing power.

example_sentences.japanese: 母：「パソコンの隣で食事をする時は、水を零さないようにきをつけて。」
example_sentences.english: Mother: 'When you are eating next to the computer, take care not to spill water on it.'

general_translation: Without worrying about
formation: Verb + の + も(1) + かまわず［い］Adjective + の + も + かまわず［な］Adjective + である + も(1) + かまわずNoun +  も(1) + かまわず(1) にも
casual_structure: Verb + の + も(1) + かまわず［い］Adjective + の + も + かまわず［な］Adjective + である + も(1) + かまわずNoun +  も(1) + かまわず(1) にも
explanation: A slightly old-fashioned way to express that not even (A) will be worried about, or braced over (given pause).

example_sentences.japanese: 御馳走もかまわず、仕事に没頭している。
example_sentences.english: Without worrying about food, they immerse themselves in their work.

example_sentences.japanese: 娘はレポートの提出日が迫っているのもかまわず、友達と遊んでばかりいる。
example_sentences.english: Without worrying about the due date of her paper, all she is doing is hanging out with friends.

example_sentences.japanese: 彼は遠いにもかまわず、広島まで休憩なしで運転し続けた。
example_sentences.english: Without worrying about the long distance, he kept driving to Hiroshima without taking a break.

example_sentences.japanese: 彼女は危険なのもかまわず、池で溺れていた猫を救出した。
example_sentences.english: Without worrying about the danger, she rescued a cat that was drowning in the lake.

example_sentences.japanese: 鈴木先輩は時間もかまわず、電話を掛けてくるから困っている。
example_sentences.english: I am annoyed because Suzuki-senpai calls me without worrying about the time.

example_sentences.japanese: 医者にストップをかけられていたにもかまわず試合に出て、大怪我をしてしまいました。
example_sentences.english: I participated in the tournament without caring about the doctor's order to stop, and got seriously injured.

example_sentences.japanese: さんざん失敗したにもかまわず、まだ研究に打ち込んでいる。
example_sentences.english: Without worrying about all of the stuff ups, I am still diving into my research.

example_sentences.japanese: サイレンにもかまわず、避難しようとしない人もいる。
example_sentences.english: Without worrying about the siren, there are people who are not willing to evacuate.

example_sentences.japanese: 錆もかまわず放置していたせいで、使えなくなってしまった。
example_sentences.english: I left it without worrying about the rust, so I ended up not being able to use it.

example_sentences.japanese: 塩辛いと感じていたにもかまわず食べ続けて、病気になってしまった。
example_sentences.english: I continued eating without worrying about sensing a salty taste and ended up getting sick.

example_sentences.japanese: 締め切りが迫っているのもかまわず、マイペースに作業していますね。
example_sentences.english: Without worrying about the deadline drawing near, he is working at his own pace.

example_sentences.japanese: 他の人の視線もかまわず、彼女は裸でダンスをした。
example_sentences.english: Without worrying about other people looking, she danced in the nude.

example_sentences.japanese: 再三の忠告もかまわず結婚し、大失敗しました。
example_sentences.english: I got married without worrying about the repeated advice I got. It was a huge failure.

example_sentences.japanese: 失敗したらどうしようという不安もかまわず、彼はみんなの前で告白した。
example_sentences.english: Without worrying about the uneasiness of what to do in case of failure, he confessed his feelings in front of everyone.

example_sentences.japanese: 医者の診断もかまわずトレーニングをし続けるのは、いい加減やめてください。
example_sentences.english: Please stop irresponsibly continuing to work out without worrying about the doctor's diagnosis.

example_sentences.japanese: 人命をかまわず利益を優先させる企業はそのうち淘汰されるでしょう。
example_sentences.english: Companies that put profit first without worrying about human life will eventually be weeded out.

example_sentences.japanese: お隣さんは、深夜でもかまわず大音量で音楽を聴く迷惑な人だ。
example_sentences.english: The neighbors are bothersome people who listen to music loudly without worrying about it being late at night.

general_translation: Cannot, Be unable to, Hard to, Hesitant to
formation: Verb［stem］+ かねる
casual_structure: Verb［stem］+ かねる
polite_structure: Verb［stem］+ かねます
explanation: A phrase showing that it will be hard to do (A), due to it causing efforts to be spread too thin, or causing actions or opinions to conflict.

example_sentences.japanese: 「役者になりたい」だなんて、賛成しかねる。
example_sentences.english: I cannot agree to (someone who says) 'I want to be an actor'. (hesitant)

example_sentences.japanese: お電話での予約受付は受けかねます。
example_sentences.english: We cannot accept reservations by phone.

example_sentences.japanese: こう言う場合でも返金はできかねます。
example_sentences.english: Even in situations like this we can't give you a refund.

example_sentences.japanese: それはお客様のプライバシーに関わる情報なのでお答えしかねます。
example_sentences.english: That is information regarding our client's privacy so we cannot answer that.

example_sentences.japanese: 専門的なプログラムには対応しかねる。
example_sentences.english: I cannot deal with a technical program. (hesitant)

example_sentences.japanese: そんな乱暴なやり方は承服しかねる。
example_sentences.english: I cannot consent to such reckless behavior. (hesitant)

example_sentences.japanese: そんな無茶な要望はお引受けしかねます。
example_sentences.english: I cannot accept such an absurd demand. (hesitant)

example_sentences.japanese: そういう方針ということでしたら、応援しかねます。
example_sentences.english: If it is that kind of policy, I cannot support it. (hesitant)

example_sentences.japanese: 個人的な理由での払い戻しはおうじかねます。
example_sentences.english: I cannot accept a refund based on personal reasons. (hesitant)

example_sentences.japanese: 儲からないと分かっている事業には投資しかねる。
example_sentences.english: I am hesitant to invest in an enterprise that knows they will not be profitable. (cannot)

example_sentences.japanese: 悪いけど、試験はこれ以上良い点数をつけかねる。
example_sentences.english: I am sorry, but I cannot give you a better score on the exam than that. (hesitant)

example_sentences.japanese: あなたは何回も約束を破っていますから、承諾しかねますね。
example_sentences.english: Time and time again you have broken promises, I cannot consent (to your request). (hesitant)

example_sentences.japanese: 面接の練習でそういう態度を取るなら、推薦しかねる。
example_sentences.english: I am hesitant to give you a recommendation if you take that attitude when practicing for your interview. (cannot)

example_sentences.japanese: 生徒：「時間旅行ができると思います。」先生：「そのような意見には、とうてい同意しかねます。」
example_sentences.english: Student: 'I think that time travel is possible.' Teacher: 'I just cannot agree with such an opinion.' (hesitant)

example_sentences.japanese: 匿名の大臣さん：「将来の財政赤字に関する首相の言葉はしんじかねる。反対するわけにもいかないので、うなずくしかない。」
example_sentences.english: Anonymous cabinet minister: 'It is hard to believe the prime minister's words about the future budget deficit. However, because I can't oppose them, I just nod.' (hesitant)

example_sentences.japanese: 弊社は内装専門なので外装に関わるお仕事はお引き受けしかねます。
example_sentences.english: It would be a bit of a stretch for us to accept exterior work, as we specialize in interiors.

general_translation: Except, With the exception of, Unless
formation: Noun + を除（のぞ）いて（は）(1)Noun + を除（のぞ）く + Noun(1) を除（のぞ）き
casual_structure: Noun + を除（のぞ）いて（は）(1)Noun + を除（のぞ）く + Noun(1) を除（のぞ）き
explanation: A formal phrase highlighting that with the exclusion of (A), (B).

example_sentences.japanese: 病院スタッフをのぞいて、入ってはならない。
example_sentences.english: With the exception of hospital staff, do not enter.

example_sentences.japanese: 高橋さんと浜崎さんをのぞいて、他のみんなは残業をしてください。
example_sentences.english: Everyone, with the exception of Takahashi-san and Hamasaki-san, please work overtime.
